title: NVIDIA Open-Sources Nemotron-Labs-Image-30B-A3B Image Generation Model: 30B-Parameter MoE Architecture, Beats GPT Image2 on Multiple Benchmarks

content_html:
NVIDIA recently quietly released the weights of the Nemotron-Labs-Image-30B-A3B model on the Hugging Face platform. The model uses a mixture-of-experts (MoE) architecture, with 30 billion total parameters, but only 3 billion parameters are activated during use, making it more suitable for local hardware.

Nemotron-Labs-Image-30B-A3B is an autoregressive image generation model and the core raster rendering engine of NVIDIA's new framework, Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation. The framework follows the "Pixel as Code" philosophy and can not only generate expressive images but also produce editable visual outputs, including web pages, slides, documents, charts, and scientific illustrations.

The model is built on Nemotron3Nano and follows the Nemotron-H hybrid design, combining Mamba-2 state-space layers with traditional attention mechanisms. It also underwent progressive mid-training and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO).

In terms of benchmark results, the model stands out across multiple benchmarks. On LongTextBench, which evaluates dense text generation accuracy, it scored 97.98, higher than GPT Image2's 96.00 and Nano Banana Pro's 97.60. On GenEval, it leads GPT Image2's 89.00 with 92.86. In addition, it achieved the highest scores in CVTG-2K (92.53), WISE Verified (91.50), and BizGenEval (86.0). However, on GenEval2, GPT Image2 has the advantage with 81.00 versus 65.43; on Qwen-Image-Bench, GPT Image2 also leads with 65.23 versus 52.46.

NVIDIA has simultaneously released the model weights and related paper on Hugging Face and arXiv for researchers and developers to download and use.

Project link: https://huggingface.co/nvidia/Nemotron-Labs-Image-30B-A3B
